start: A new member's page as owner; a 3-month plan with a joining fee exists

steps.action: Open the sell sheet and pick the plan
user_sees: Start = today, end = the day before the same date three months on, the plan's price, the plan's joining fee
must_not: An end date one day long or short; no joining fee for a first plan

steps.action: Type the amount received and its date, save
user_sees: The plan on the member with paid and due adding up
must_not: 'Amount received is more than the total.' missed; a receipt dated in the future

start: A new member's page as front-desk staff; a 3-month plan with a joining fee exists

steps.action: Open the sell sheet and pick the plan
user_sees: Start = today, the plan's price and joining fee
must_not: A lower default price than the plan's

steps.action: Keep the price within 10% off, keep the joining fee, type the amount received, save
user_sees: The plan saved
must_not: A sale saved on this device that the server then refuses, with no word

start: Another kind as owner: renew a member whose plan runs till a day next month (and one who also has a plan paid ahead)

steps.action: Open the sell sheet and pick a plan
user_sees: Start = the day after the last day they are covered (after the paid-ahead plan too); joining fee 0 because one was paid or the member was imported; a renewal starting then is not asked about even when 30+ days away
must_not: A start date inside time already bought; a joining fee charged again

steps.action: Save
user_sees: Cover runs on without a gap or an overlap
must_not: The member's expiry unchanged after paying

start: Sell sheet as owner; wrong input

steps.action: Save with no plan; with an unreadable price, fee or amount
user_sees: 'Pick a plan first.' / 'The price looks wrong. Type it again.' / 'The joining fee looks wrong. Type it again.' / 'The amount received looks wrong. Type it again.'
must_not: A sale saved with an empty price

steps.action: Pick a start date inside the current plan
user_sees: 'They already have a plan from <day> to <day>. Start the new plan after that.' or 'Their plan already runs till <day>. Start the new plan after that.'
must_not: Time sold twice

steps.action: Type a price above the plan's, or a start more than 30 days away
user_sees: One message with every reason, ending 'Tap again to save it anyway.'
must_not: Saved on the first tap; only the first reason shown

start: Sell sheet as front-desk staff; the desk's limits

steps.action: Pick a start date far back
user_sees: 'The front desk can start a plan at most <n> days back. Ask the owner for an older start date.'
must_not: A back-dated plan saved by the desk

steps.action: Type a price more than 10% under the plan's
user_sees: 'The front desk can give at most 10% off. The lowest price is <amount>. Ask the owner for a bigger discount.'
must_not: A bigger discount saved by the desk

steps.action: For a member with no plan yet, lower the joining fee
user_sees: 'The joining fee for a new member is <amount>. Only the owner can remove it.'
must_not: The fee removed by the desk

start: As owner; a wrong plan sold to a new member a minute ago, nothing paid

steps.action: Cancel that plan, open the sell sheet and pick the right plan
user_sees: The joining fee is asked again (the cancelled plan took none); start = today
must_not: The fee skipped because a cancelled, unpaid plan carried one; the cancelled plan's unpaid money in the dues total

steps.action: Sell, then renew once more
user_sees: No fee on the renewal
must_not: A fee on every renewal
